adidas × Pokémon Timed Research

Fri, Sep 25, 2026, 10:00 AM → Fri, Jan 15, 2027, 8:00 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

A store-based Timed Research for the adidas × Pokémon collection. It rewards an adidas jacket and cap for your avatar.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

How to get it

  • Open Pokémon GO while at a participating adidas or retail store to receive the research (available until Jan 15, 2027, 8 p.m. local).
  • Finish it by Feb 13, 2027. Tasks give XP, Stardust, a Lucario encounter and Lucario Mega Energy.

Tip

We couldn't confirm a redeemable code for this one, so we don't list one.
